details: A membership-query decision tree supplies a specifying set for every labeling. For finite classes with more than two concepts, Hegedüs also proves $Q_m\leq \mathrm{XTD}\log_2|\mathcal{H}|$.
name: Membership Query Complexity / Extended Teaching Dimension
proof: Fix a target labeling. Along a membership-query decision-tree path identifying it, the queried coordinates and their answers distinguish that labeling from every other member of the class, so they form a specifying set. The worst path length is therefore at least $\mathrm{XTD}(\mathcal H)$.
